# cato_always_on_rule_bulk (Resource)

Manages ordering of existing Always On policy sections and rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// enforce Always On for a single user
resource "cato_always_on_rule" "enforce_user" {
  at = {
    position = "LAST_IN_POLICY"
  }
  rule = {
    name              = "Enforce Always On for jdoe"
    enabled           = true
    action            = "ENFORCE"
    allow_fail_open   = false
    allow_user_bypass = false
    anti_tamper_mode  = "OFF"
    bypass_duration = {
      time = 30
      unit = "MINUTES"
    }
    source = {
      users = [
        {
          # id   = "123456"
          name = "jdoe"
        },
      ]
    }
  }
}

resource "cato_always_on_section" "ao_section" {
  at = {
    position = "LAST_IN_POLICY"
  }
  section = {
    name = "Always-On Section"
  }
}

# cato_always_on_rule.kitchen_sink:
resource "cato_always_on_rule" "kitchen_sink" {
  at = {
    position = "FIRST_IN_SECTION"
    ref      = cato_always_on_section.ao_section.section.id
  }
  rule = {
    name              = "Always-On Kitchen Sink"
    description       = "test"
    enabled           = true
    action            = "ENFORCE"
    allow_fail_open   = true
    allow_user_bypass = true
    anti_tamper_mode  = "PROTECT"
    bypass_duration = {
      time = 1
      unit = "HOURS"
    }
    platform = [
      "WINDOWS",
      "MACOS",
    ]
    device_posture_profile = [
      {
        # id   = "4202"
        name = "Test Device Posture Profile"
      },
    ]
    source = {
      users = [
        {
          # id   = "0"
          name = "test user"
        },
      ]
      user_groups = [
        {
          # id   = "500000000"
          name = "Test User Group"
        },
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `publish_trigger` (String) Changing this value triggers ordering and publishing after dependent rules and sections are updated. Use sha256(jsonencode(...)) over the complete rule and section configuration, and depends_on for those resources, to publish content-only changes in the same apply.
- `rule_data` (Attributes Map) Map of Always On rule positions keyed by rule name. Rules may move between sections; include every rule exactly once. Omit to preserve live rule ordering. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule_data))
- `section_data` (Attributes Map) Map of Always On section positions keyed by section name. Omit to preserve the live section order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--section_data))

### Read-Only

- `changes` (Number) Internal flag

<a id="nestedatt--rule_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_data`

Required:

- `index_in_section` (Number) Position of the rule within its section, starting at 1
- `section_name` (String) Name of the parent Always On section, matching a section_data map key

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Always On rule ID


<a id="nestedatt--section_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `section_data`

Required:

- `section_index` (Number) Position of the section within the policy, starting at 1

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Always On policy section ID
